objectives.text: Recognize which pattern fits a short problem statement: a HashMap frequency count, a HashSet of seen values, an ArrayDeque stack, or two pointers
Solve a short problem inside a time box by restating the inputs and outputs, listing edge cases, then coding and testing the simplest correct version
State a solution's time complexity in Big-O terms out loud

minutes.basis: intake planning estimate under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (budget at least ceil(max(estimator P50, modeledWorstPath)), 15-minute ceiling, no day-pool shares). Planned page: a review page with timed pattern-recognition and plan-then-code practice. modeledP50 9 is the planned estimator P50 and modeledWorstPath 12 the planned worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit); no artifact.html exists yet, so the lambdas-and-streams module PR re-measures both with the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py on the authored bytes and raises budget and aboutLabel if the measured minimum is higher. See authoring/evidence/collections-streams/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
